subject: Request: combined credits + discount for Novae PoC (exec approval)
messages:
From: Ari Chen <ari.chen@novae.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC ask — credits + extended trial + discount

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team at Novae is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model-cost controls. We're lining up procurement and security review, but two items are blocking our ability to sign this month: 1) we need a longer PoC window to validate inference at scale (looking for 60 days), and 2) procurement is asking for an applied credit pool (~$50,000) to cover early usage while we ramp.

Additionally, given the size of the evaluation we would like to discuss a 20% discount on first-year committed usage if we convert to a paid agreement within 90 days. We know this is an exception; if you can outline what internal approvals you'd need and any guardrails, that would help speed our procurement ask.

I've attached a short requirements workbook that shows expected token volumes and compliance checkpoints (attachment: novae-poc-requirements.xlsx).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can consider a combined credit + discount package, and what approvals are required?

Best,
Ari Chen
Head of Platforms, Novae Labs
Ari Chen | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari.chen@novae.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC ask — credits + extended trial + discount

Ari — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the workbook. Quick read-through confirms the volume profile you shared is a realistic ramp for the PoC. I'm looping in Ben (Sales Manager) and Vivek (VP Sales) — this request needs approval from leadership because it combines a sizeable credit pool + a first-year discount.

Proposed internal counter to speed things up:
- Trial length: 45 days (we can push to 60 with stronger commit)
- Applied credits: $30,000 up front toward token usage (we can authorize up to $40k with exec signoff)
- First-year conversion discount: 15% if Novae commits to $60k ARR within 6 months of conversion

Ben — attaching a quick pricing impact that shows expected net revenue over 12 months at each band (attachment: pricing_impact_novae_20260510.xlsx). Can you advise approval delta and whether finance needs to weigh in?

Ari — if you can confirm the conversion commitment terms (target ARR and timeline), I can fast-track a term sheet and a DocuSign route once we have internal signoff.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tessa Morgan | tessa.morgan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC ask — credits + extended trial + discount

Tessa / Vivek — reviewed the pricing impact. Quick notes:
- I can approve up to $30k in applied credits for a PoC, provided we get a written conversion commitment to $60k ARR within 6 months.
- Anything over $30k (up to $40k) requires Vivek signoff.
- The 15% discount on first-year usage is acceptable as a conditional concession tied to that $60k ARR commitment.

If we approve $30k + 15% now, we should require a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a clause that credits are drawn down only for production-grade usage. That protects Redwood if the PoC is purely exploratory.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC ask — credits + extended trial + discount

Tessa / Ben — after reviewing the customer profile and the ARR potential, I'm prepared to approve a one-time exception with the following guardrails:

- Applied credits: $40,000 (one-time pool, non-refundable, to be consumed during the PoC)
- Trial extension: 45 days standard; Novae may use up to 60 days if they sign a memorandum of conversion (MOC) committing to $60k ARR within 90 days of PoC end
- First-year discount: 20% on first-year committed spend, conditional on the $60k ARR convert within the specified timeline
- Requirements: (1) Legal to review and accept a short MAP that defines production traffic gates; (2) Credits only apply to production-grade inference calls (we'll define this in the MAP); (3) DocuSign execution prior to credit activation

I've attached a short approval memo for finance/legal (attachment: approval_memo_vivek_20260512.pdf). Please route the updated MSA/term sheet via DocuSign and update HubSpot (deal id DEAL-7894) with the approved variations.

Note: Any further concessions beyond $40k or longer trial without conversion will need CRO signoff.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari.chen@novae.ai>

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC ask — credits + extended trial + discount

Ari — good news: leadership approved a one-time exception with clear guardrails. Summary of approved terms below (please review and confirm):

- Applied credits: $40,000 one-time pool to be applied during PoC
- Trial window: 45 days; may extend to 60 days only if Novae signs a Memorandum of Conversion (MOC) committing to $60k ARR within 90 days after PoC end
- First-year conversion discount: 20% on first-year committed spend, conditional on the $60k ARR commitment
- Activation: credits will be enabled only after DocuSign execution of the MAP + MSA amendment; credits are only valid for production-grade inference calls as defined in the MAP

Next steps:
1) I'll share an updated term sheet + MAP and route via DocuSign (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC123-novae-msa).
2) Once signed, finance will enable the credit pool and we'll schedule onboarding with Solutions Engineering.
3) Please confirm acceptance of the guardrails and the commitment language (we can share an editable MOC if you prefer).

Thanks for moving quickly on this — looking forward to getting Novae running on Redwood.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
